title: Project: merging logs from many pods

exercises.title: A k-way merge
exercises.task: Each pod's log is sorted by time. Write MergeAll: one timeline of every entry, in O(N log k) for N entries from k pods, with a heap holding the next entry of each pod. The spec is in the file.
hints: The heap holds one cursor per pod that still has entries: (pod, index of its next entry). The top is the cursor whose entry has the smallest time; on a tie, the smaller pod number.
Loop: pop the top cursor, append its entry, and if that pod has more entries, push the cursor again with index+1 (or change it in place and call heap.Fix(h, 0)).
Two pods is the merge of 1.5.2; the heap only answers "which of the k heads is smallest?" in O(log k) instead of comparing all k.
